<!--
Thanks for contributing! Read CONTRIBUTING.md before filling this out.
Keep answers short and specific; a sentence or two per section is often enough.
Remove these instructions before submitting.

For humans and coding agents:
- Report only checks actually run and evidence you have. Don't invent user
  requests, results, or demo links.
- Distinguish agent-run checks from testing personally performed by the contributor.
- If testing or a required demo is missing, say it's still needed.
- Don't promise follow-up work on someone else's behalf.
- Leave checklist items unchecked until confirmed. Agents must not claim
  personal testing or contributor confirmation on the contributor's behalf.
-->

## What does this change, and why?

<!-- Explain the problem or use case and how this change helps.
Link related issues or PRs. -->

## Who does this help?

<!-- Oh My Zsh should make the command line more delightful.
How does this make someone's day easier, clearer, or more enjoyable?

A personal itch is a welcome starting point, and a change needn't help everyone.
Describe the users or workflows you expect it to help and why it belongs in
the shared project. Link actual requests or examples if available; otherwise,
explain your reasoning.

For new aliases, describe common workflows and why other plugin users would
benefit from having them. -->

## Show the change

<!-- Include screenshots, a GIF, or a short video for user-facing changes.
Show and label before/after behavior, or demonstrate a new feature in use.
Keep terminal text readable and remove private information from recordings.

For low-level or other non-visual changes, briefly explain why a visual isn't
useful. If you can't capture a required demo yet, say it's still needed. -->

## How did you test it?

<!-- Describe what was run or tried and the results. Distinguish automated or
agent-run checks from testing you personally performed. Include relevant OS,
Zsh, or tool versions and anything still untested.
For documentation-only changes, describe what you checked. -->

## How will users discover it?

<!-- For features or enhancements, describe how you'll help others find and
use them: a plugin README update, a usage example, or sharing your demo.
Distinguish what's included here from follow-up work you intend to do.
Delete this section if it doesn't apply. -->

## Other notes

<!-- Include compatibility concerns or anything needing particular attention.
If you meaningfully used AI tools, briefly disclose their role here.
Basic autocomplete doesn't need disclosure.
Delete this section if it isn't needed. -->

## Submission checklist

<!-- Check confirmed items with [x]. For conditional items, check them if the
condition doesn't apply. Mark other inapplicable items with "N/A" and a brief
reason rather than claiming checks you haven't performed. -->

- [ ] The PR title clearly describes the change.
- [ ] I've searched for existing PRs and confirmed this isn't a duplicate.
- [ ] I've read and followed the [contribution guidelines](https://github.com/ohmyzsh/ohmyzsh/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] My code follows the [code style guide](https://github.com/ohmyzsh/ohmyzsh/wiki/Code-Style-Guide).
- [ ] I wrote this code or can contribute it under an MIT-compatible license.
- [ ] If I meaningfully used AI tools, I've disclosed their role in "Other notes" above.
- [ ] I've included a visual demonstration or explained why a visual isn't useful for this change.
- [ ] I've considered performance and avoided unnecessary work or resource use.
- [ ] I've personally tested the change and described the results and any testing limitations above.
- [ ] If I've added aliases, I've explained why they're useful for common workflows among the plugin's users.
